name: save-boot-13b-equipment-menu
description: #117: the equipped weapon, armor and accessory of records 0 and 1 (Cloud, Barret; Barret has none, 0xFF) and four of record 0's materia slots (weapon 0 and 1, armor 0 and 1) in RAM equal the author-chosen values of harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-inventory.json. Load, open the field menu with Triangle (as save-boot-10a), then check each value with equals (1/0 only; metrics for record 0's equipment and its first weapon and armor materia). match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state.
